title: Unit Test Evidence Bundle
description: The artifact's unit test run is captured: counts, durations, and the hash of the full log. The bundle lets anyone re-verify the unit results without re-running them. Teaching ladder: rank 1 — the concept in its simplest, most direct form.

demo.title: Runnable code demo — Unit Test Evidence Bundle
demo.program:
# Executable artifact test evidence: Unit Test Evidence Bundle
import hashlib, json
artifact = "lib-core v2.4.1"; tests = "842 unit tests".split(";")
results = {t: "PASS" for t in tests}
evidence = {"artifact": artifact, "tests_run": results,
             "evidence_hash": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(results, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]}
print(json.dumps(evidence, indent=2))
assert all(v == "PASS" for v in results.values())
print("OK - machine-checkable test evidence recorded")
